features: Get NVMe solid state performance featuring 1050MB/s** read and 1000MB/s** write speeds in a portable, high-capacity drive that’s perfect for creating amazing content or capturing incredible footage.
Up to two-meter drop protection and IP55 water and dust resistance mean this tough drive can take a beating.
Travel worry-free with a 5-year limited warranty provided by SanDisk and a durable silicone shell that offers a premium feel and added protection to the drive’s exterior.
Help keep private content private with the included password protection featuring 256‐bit AES hardware encryption
Use the handy carabiner loop to secure it to your belt loop or backpack for extra peace of mind
Easily manage files and automatically free up space with the SanDisk Memory Zone app
